line_text: Well, I believe we're  going to pay our bills, and I don't think we're going to default. It would be catastrophic. It would be a self-inflicted wound on the greatest economy in the world. Why would we want to do that? Pay our bills, and then let's discuss, honestly, how to reduce the deficit.
quote: Pay our bills, and then let's discuss, honestly, how to reduce the deficit.
rationale: Asked whether there would be a debt-ceiling deal, said the country would pay its bills, that he did not expect a default, and that the deficit conversation should follow rather than ride on the ceiling. That sequencing states the instrument in the right direction -- the ceiling is permission to borrow for obligations already incurred, not a spending control -- which is the exact negation of this sub area's harmful inversion ('the debt ceiling is how we cut spending'). Nothing further was named: no extraordinary measures, no X-date, no default-versus-prioritization fork, no desk (Treasury, Fed, Congress) placed, and no number. 'Catastrophic' and 'a self-inflicted wound' are characterisation, not mechanism. MECHANISM only, stated in plain English; no ANCHOR, no AUTHORITY, no FALSIFIER.

line_text: I mean, let's talk about repealing some of Trump's  tax cuts on the very wealthy. Let's talk about repealing some of George W. Bush's tax cuts on the very wealthy. quote: Let's talk about scrapping the cap on Social Security after $250,000. Let's talk about certain defense cuts so we don't have a trillion-dollar defense.
rationale: Asked what he would put on the table to reduce the deficit, listed four named levers: repealing part of the Trump tax cuts on high earners, repealing part of the Bush tax cuts on high earners, applying the Social Security payroll tax again above a $250,000 threshold, and holding the defense topline below a trillion dollars. He named the payer class each lever falls on ('the very wealthy', earners above $250,000) and said he had put proposals on the table. He did not state the residual identity or the three paths that close it, did not distinguish statutory from economic incidence or name an elasticity, did not size any lever against the gap, and named no bill and no vote. ANCHOR (four live instruments, a dollar threshold, a topline figure) + LOSER (the payer class named), with MECHANISM only implied and no FALSIFIER. Substitution-checked: the same list of named formula levers pointed the other way -- retirement age, benefit indexation, means-testing -- at this depth reads at the same number.

quote: we should first stop the price gouging of hospitals and make sure that there's not aggressive debt collection, but then we should set up a federal fund for those hospitals to be able to be compensated for the legitimate debt.
rationale: Sequenced the remedy: stop hospital price gouging and aggressive collection first, then compensate hospitals from a federal fund for what he called the legitimate debt. He named no pricing mechanism behind the charge (no facility-fee differential here, no chargemaster, no consolidation, no certificate of need), no agency holding the pen, and no number on the price side.
